title: Duplicate shops, encounters and NPCs; filters that stay put
summary: DMs can copy a shop with its stock, an encounter with its loot, or an NPC's setup in one step, and list filters are remembered per campaign.
items: Duplicate shop makes "<name> (copy)" with the same settings and stock; the original is untouched.
Duplicate on a saved encounter makes a fresh draft with the same combatants and loot, reset to round 1.
Duplicate NPC opens a new NPC form filled from the original; the copy starts with no coins or items.
Review Inbox's type filter and the inventory's Holder, Category and Equipped filters are remembered for each campaign on this device.
